title: Thinking on Describing What You Do and How You Do It
summary: Kahran and Divya land on a problem statement for Joyus faster than they expected, and use that to dig into why so many companies can't agree on what they do — every employee resonates with a different leader's version of the story, and small teams end up feeling like the priorities shift. Divya shares her therapist exercise before an AI panel where she realized she'd written a paragraph that didn't sound like her, and the imposter syndrome that came back once she started a company.
topics: writing about yourself with the focus on the work

intents.display: to land on how to describe what you and your company actually do
